newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA buys 54,000T U.S. soybeans at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA buys 54,000T U.S. soybeans at tender.

text.p: The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans from Cargill at a tender on Tuesday, traders said.
The Breakfast association's Taichung division consists of Sino Japan Feed Corp, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed, Fwu Sow Grain, and Tay Shan .
Details of the tender are as follows:
27,000 soy U.S. Gulf Pacific N.W. US$290.91/CNF 27,000 soy Dec 26-Jan 9 Jan 10-24 90.85 US Cents/Mar
